decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the required high-speed splash behavior and the accepted conditional mitigation methods.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records that mixing must remain smooth and not become overly aggressive at higher speeds.
The source changes mixing speed and high-speed mixing behavior, not the beverage dispensing flow or froth preservation through the spout.
The source conditionally permits whisk-position adjustment as a splash-control measure but does not establish a new whisk head, material, size, or required position.
Accepting the 3000 RPM speed range does not change the existing general requirement for reliable event operation.
The source only conditionally mentions dialing in bowl depth if needed and does not change the selected bowl capacity, form, or size.
The motor-speed decision does not change the confirmed 120V wall-power architecture or battery policy.
The source does not specify any change to the base, feet, vibration control, or structural-stability requirement.
The selected motor may affect BOM contents operationally, but the source does not change the requirement to deliver a prototype BOM or any stored BOM attribute.
The source does not change the solenoid mechanism, button actuation, closed-state behavior, or dispensing isolation.
The higher-speed mixing decision does not alter the established bowl or spout cleaning requirements.
The source does not change the requirement for rapid bowl removal and swapping during events.
